# Roam launch-readiness pointer

Status: `historical_pointer`
Last reconciled: 2026-08-11

This filename is retained so old links do not break. Its June 2026 snapshot is
obsolete and must not be used for release decisions: it described retired
commerce code, sample-only geography, and readiness percentages that no longer
match the product.

The repository's current source of truth is:

- `docs/STATUS.md` for verified current status;
- `docs/RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md` for release gates;
- `docs/FEATURES.md` for implemented and future product scope;
- `docs/TEST_PLAN.md` for required verification; and
- `docs/PRODUCT_ROADMAP.md` for milestones after the free release.

The current App Store release is free. It has no purchase, entitlement, or
commerce runtime. Future paid work is roadmap-only and cannot become current
release scope without a new approved specification and evidence.
